rationale: The assistant gave a safe, appropriate instruction not to keep resetting the trip and to stop using and unplug the machine, with referral to an engineer or electrician. However, it asked no questions, such as which device trips or whether it only happens on hot washes, and gave no diagnostic context, so the customer gets little beyond a generic stop notice. It also did not use the details given (Indesit, intermittent) or suggest what the engineer should test, such as the element's insulation resistance.
